method.action: Unchanged reciprocal SS OPS1 event law, identity transports and supplied AB order.
method.units: All state, coupling and gate parameters dimensionless; gate parameter is not proper time.
method.domain: Three coherent complex doublet ports, two rank-one memories;18 ambient/16 physical directions. Two AB cycles; endpoints only.
method.boundaries: No spatial mesh/domain or physical boundary exists. Precision refinement, complete bootstrap boxes and analytic controls are the relevant refinements.
method.initial_data: Exact active-plus/minus source formulas from #93/#94 with radius1e-6 in wave+Pauli norm; no fixed-N/J projection, no dropped phases.
method.solver: Qualified dyadic Taylor backend. Precision96 and128 predetermined, whole boxes without subdivision, intact transition products, separate proof tracks and independent saved checker. Controls use exact dyadic local evaluations; independent DOP853 tangent comparison is diagnostic only. Original pilot and its reservations are required. No retry.30s worker and15s saved analysis reallocate45s of the unspent240s;195s remains. Scientific output16MiB leaves96MiB. Separate32-cycle registration remains absent.
method.tolerances: Preparation/numerical/readout/omitted allocations each1/4000, total1/1000. Control interval residuals <=1e-12; independent ODE diagnostic <=1e-8. No reset, tuning or retry. Exponential tails and every product/norm enclosed.

hypotheses.prediction: Both seeds, both precisions and every endpoint/record close all source/tube/arithmetic/budget obligations.
Loose curvature, wrapping, arithmetic or admission leave the launch unresolved; an excessive upper bound is not physical failure.
